fields.name: reasonReplacement
fields.label: Replacement of lost, stolen, or damaged employment authorization document, or correction of my employment authorization document NOT DUE to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) error

fields.name: reasonRenewal
fields.label: Renewal of my permission to accept employment
fields.helpText: Attach a copy of your previous employment authorization document.

subsections.title: Other Names Used
subsections.helpText: Provide all other names you have ever used, including aliases, maiden name, and nicknames. If you need extra space to complete this section, use the space provided in Part 6. Additional Information.

fields.name: mailingAddressSameAsPhysical
fields.label: Is your current mailing address the same as your physical address?

subsections.title: U.S. Physical Address
subsections.helpText: If you answered 'No' to Item Number 6., provide your physical address below.

fields.name: previouslyFiledI765
fields.label: Have you previously filed Form I-765?

fields.name: ssaIssuedCard
fields.label: Has the Social Security Administration (SSA) ever officially issued a Social Security card to you?

fields.name: ssn
fields.label: Provide your Social Security number (SSN) (if known)

fields.name: wantSsnCard
fields.label: Do you want the SSA to issue you a Social Security card?
fields.helpText: You must also answer 'Yes' to Item Number 15., Consent for Disclosure, to receive a card.

fields.name: consentForDisclosure
fields.label: Consent for Disclosure: I authorize disclosure of information from this application to the SSA as required for the purpose of assigning me an SSN and issuing me a Social Security card.

subsections.title: Parent Information
subsections.helpText: If you answered 'Yes' to Item Numbers 14. - 15., provide the information requested in Item Numbers 16.a. - 17.b.

subsections.title: Your Country or Countries of Citizenship or Nationality
subsections.helpText: List all countries where you are currently a citizen or national. If you need extra space to complete this item, use the space provided in Part 6. Additional Information.

subsections.title: Place of Birth
subsections.helpText: List the city/town/village, state/province, and country where you were born.

subsections.title: Information About Your Last Arrival in the United States

fields.name: i94Number
fields.label: Form I-94 Arrival-Departure Record Number (if any)

fields.name: passportNumber
fields.label: Passport Number of Your Most Recently Issued Passport

fields.name: passportCountry
fields.label: Country That Issued Your Passport or Travel Document

fields.name: passportExpiration
fields.label: Expiration Date for Passport or Travel Document (mm/dd/yyyy)

fields.name: dateOfLastArrival
fields.label: Date of Your Last Arrival Into the United States, On or About (mm/dd/yyyy)

fields.name: placeOfLastArrival
fields.label: Place of Your Last Arrival Into the United States

fields.name: immigrationStatusAtArrival
fields.label: Immigration Status at Your Last Arrival (for example, B-2 visitor, F-1 student, or no status)

fields.name: currentImmigrationStatus
fields.label: Your Current Immigration Status or Category (for example, B-2 visitor, F-1 student, parolee, deferred action, or no status or category)

fields.name: sevisNumber
fields.label: Student and Exchange Visitor Information System (SEVIS) Number (if any)

fields.name: eligibilityCategory
fields.label: Eligibility Category
fields.helpText: Refer to the Who May File Form I-765 section of the Form I-765 Instructions to determine the appropriate eligibility category for this application. Enter the appropriate letter and number for your eligibility category below (for example, (a)(8), (c)(17)(iii)).

subsections.title: (c)(3)(C) STEM OPT Eligibility Category
subsections.helpText: If you entered the eligibility category (c)(3)(C) in Item Number 27., provide the information requested in Item Numbers 28.a - 28.c.

fields.name: stemOptEmployerName
fields.label: Employer's Name as Listed in E-Verify

fields.name: stemOptEVerifyNumber
fields.label: Employer's E-Verify Company Identification Number or a Valid E-Verify Client Company Identification Number

subsections.title: (c)(26) Eligibility Category
subsections.helpText: If you entered the eligibility category (c)(26) in Item Number 27., provide the receipt number of your H-1B spouse's most recent Form I-797 Notice for Form I-129, Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker.

subsections.title: (c)(8) Eligibility Category
subsections.helpText: If you entered the eligibility category (c)(8) in Item Number 27.

fields.name: c8ArrestedConvicted
fields.label: Have you EVER been arrested for and/or convicted of any crime?

subsections.title: (c)(35) and (c)(36) Eligibility Category
subsections.helpText: If you entered the eligibility category (c)(35) in Item Number 27., please provide the receipt number of your Form I-797 Notice for Form I-140, Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker. If you entered the eligibility category (c)(36) in Item Number 27., please provide the receipt number of your spouse's or parent's Form I-797 Notice for Form I-140.

fields.name: c35c36ArrestedConvicted
fields.label: If you entered the eligibility category (c)(35) or (c)(36) in Item Number 27., have you EVER been arrested for and/or convicted of any crime?

sections.title: Applicant's Statement, Contact Information, Declaration, Certification, and Signature

subsections.title: Applicant's Statement
subsections.helpText: Select the box for either Item Number 1.a. or 1.b. If applicable, select the box for Item Number 2.

fields.name: applicantCanReadEnglish
fields.label: I can read and understand English, and I have read and understand every question and instruction on this application and my answer to every question.

fields.name: applicantUsedInterpreter
fields.label: The interpreter named in Part 4. read to me every question and instruction on this application and my answer to every question in

fields.name: interpreterLanguage
fields.label: Language
fields.helpText: a language in which I am fluent, and I understood everything.

fields.name: applicantUsedPreparer
fields.label: At my request, the preparer named in Part 5., prepared this application for me based only upon information I provided or authorized.

fields.name: abcSettlementEligible
fields.label: Select this box if you are a Salvadoran or Guatemalan national eligible for benefits under the ABC settlement agreement.

sections.title: Interpreter's Contact Information, Certification, and Signature
sections.helpText: Provide the following information about the interpreter.

fields.name: interpreterBusinessName
fields.label: Interpreter's Business or Organization Name (if any)

fields.name: interpreterFluentLanguage
fields.label: I am fluent in English and
fields.helpText: which is the same language specified in Part 3., Item Number 1.b.

sections.title: Contact Information, Declaration, and Signature of the Person Preparing this Application, If Other Than the Applicant
sections.helpText: Provide the following information about the preparer.

fields.name: preparerBusinessName
fields.label: Preparer's Business or Organization Name (if any)

fields.name: preparerNotAttorney
fields.label: I am not an attorney or accredited representative but have prepared this application on behalf of the applicant and with the applicant's consent.

fields.label: I am an attorney or accredited representative and my representation of the applicant in this case

fields.name: preparerRepresentationExtends

sections.title: Additional Information
sections.helpText: If you need extra space to provide any additional information within this application, use the space below.

If you answered 'No' to Item Number 14., skip to Part 2., Item Number 18.a. If you answered 'Yes' to Item Number 14., you must also answer 'Yes' to Item Number 15.
If you answered 'Yes' to Item Numbers 14. - 15., provide the information requested in Item Numbers 16.a. - 17.b.
If you entered the eligibility category (c)(3)(C) in Item Number 27., provide the information requested in Item Numbers 28.a - 28.c.
If you entered the eligibility category (c)(26) in Item Number 27., provide the receipt number of your H-1B spouse's most recent Form I-797 Notice for Form I-129, Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker.
If you entered the eligibility category (c)(8) in Item Number 27., have you EVER been arrested for and/or convicted of any crime?

If you entered the eligibility category (c)(35) in Item Number 27., please provide the receipt number of your Form I-797 Notice for Form I-140, Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker. If you entered the eligibility category (c)(36) in Item Number 27., please provide the receipt number of your spouse's or parent's Form I-797 Notice for Form I-140.
